title: Bea Kadri shares a wonderful single "Outpour"
htmlContent:
Bea Kadri presents a new track called "Outpour," a real music that people will always run to when they need a reason to keep going. It’s soulful and honest, while still being top class music. From the writing, production and vocal approach, it all hits the mark in superb fashion to truly make this an amazing debut for her fans to enjoy.
